title: google_genai: resolve quoted annotations of function activity tools

files.patch:
@@ -244,6 +244,23 @@ class whose ``__call__`` is not a function, staticmethod,
         sig = inspect.signature(schema_fn)
         annotations = getattr(schema_fn, "__annotations__", {})
         doc = schema_fn.__doc__
+        # A quoted annotation (or `from __future__ import annotations`) can
+        # only be resolved in the function's own module: the wrapper has other
+        # globals, so Gemini would leave it a string and fail on it.
+        try:
+            hints = typing.get_type_hints(fn, include_extras=True)
+        except Exception as e:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Cannot read the parameters of {getattr(fn, '__name__', fn)}: {e}"
+            ) from e
+        sig = sig.replace(
+            parameters=[
+                p.replace(annotation=hints.get(p.name, p.annotation))
+                for p in sig.parameters.values()
+            ],
+            return_annotation=hints.get("return", sig.return_annotation),
+        )
+        annotations = {**annotations, **hints}
 
     activity_name: str = ret.name

+@activity.defn
+async def quoted_parcel_status(parcel_id: "str", note: "list[str]") -> "str":
+    """Report a parcel's status."""
+    return f"{parcel_id}: {', '.join(note)}"
+
+
+def test_activity_as_tool_resolves_quoted_annotations():
+    """A quoted annotation on a function activity is resolved in its own module."""
+    from google.genai._extra_utils import convert_argument_from_function
+
+    tool = activity_as_tool(
+        quoted_parcel_status,
+        activity_config=ActivityConfig(start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(seconds=5)),
+    )
+    args = convert_argument_from_function(
+        {"parcel_id": "P-1", "note": ["a", "b"]}, tool
+    )
+    assert args == {"parcel_id": "P-1", "note": ["a", "b"]}
+
+
